note: Reviewed ledger of every backend endpoint that no UI application reaches while at least one sibling endpoint on the same controller IS reached. Entries are recorded facts, not approvals: an entry of class UI_GAP is an open gap awaiting UI work, and this file exists so that neither the gap nor its classification can change without a human editing it. The audit and the tests fail when the measured set differs from this ledger, in either direction.

classes.UI_GAP: Human-facing, guarded, and genuinely not reachable. The surrounding screen works; this step of it is missing. Open work, not an exception.
classes.NODE_PROTOCOL: Node-to-node or edge protocol. The counterparty lives outside this repository.
classes.DEVICE_INGEST: Posted by a device adapter, not by a person at a screen.
classes.PROVIDER_CALLBACK: Public webhook called by an external provider; a browser cannot originate it.
classes.SUPERSEDED: No caller in the repository and its data is already delivered through another reachable endpoint.

entries.reason: Guarded by Permissions attendance.device_ingest and posted by the fingerprint device adapter rather than by a person. Admin already manages attendance devices through the reachable siblings GET /attendance/devices, PATCH /attendance/devices/:id and POST /attendance/devices, so this ingest endpoint has no UI counterpart to be missing from.

No caller anywhere in the repository, and the Admin runtime does not need it: apps/admin/app/domain-workspaces.ts derives the module set from GET /platform/manifest through enabledModuleCodes(manifest) instead.
